tool.name: geometry_review
tool.description: Inspect element bounding boxes and positions in mm; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: solid_audit
tool.description: Inspect solid volumes, surfaces and room boundaries; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: verified_move
tool.description: Move an unhosted point family with stale position protection; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: straight_rebar
tool.description: Create experimental straight native reinforcement; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: rebar_set
tool.description: Distribute an existing straight rebar as a fixed-number set; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: solid_clash
tool.description: Check actual solid intersections for explicit pairs; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: family_type_flex
tool.description: Duplicate family type and verify height variation; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: bent_rebar
tool.description: Create experimental planar bent reinforcement; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: mep_topology
tool.description: Inspect physical end connectors; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: clearance_screen
tool.description: Screen bounding-box clearance; not exact solid distance; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: mep_connect
tool.description: Connect matching coincident opposed MEP ends; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: sloped_floor
tool.description: Create sloped floor, not native ramp; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: material_takeoff
tool.description: Extract Revit material quantities; approved full-trust extension in test project only.

tool.name: paint_top_face
tool.description: Create graphic finish material and paint a single planar floor top face; preserves existing finish and structural layers. Test copy only.

tool.name: wall_attach_roof
tool.description: Attach up to 20 explicit walls to a roof using native Revit 2025.2+ attachment and verify attachment IDs. Test copy only.

tool.name: rebar_inventory
tool.description: Read native bar counts, actual centerline lengths and theoretical nominal steel mass

tool.name: checked_wall_opening
tool.description: Create rectangular wall opening and verify net host volume reduction; no structural design

tool.name: mep_split
tool.description: Split disconnected straight native pipe or duct; verify lengths and type

tool.name: view_review
tool.description: Set projection line color, category visibility or display style, with readback

tool.name: native_material_schedule
tool.description: Create native material takeoff with name, area and volume fields

tool.name: closed_stirrup
tool.description: Experimental native rectangular stirrup outline; no hooks or structural certification

tool.name: layer_audit
tool.description: Read compound structure layers and nominal thickness

tool.name: layer_variant
tool.description: Duplicate native compound type, edit layers and verify source unchanged

tool.name: sheet_review
tool.description: Audit viewport boxes and schedule points or edit viewport center/scale; not full sheet collision check

tool.name: material_appearance
tool.description: List generic render assets or duplicate material and set generic diffuse color; no textures

tool.name: schedule_review
tool.description: Audit, sort, group, filter and explicitly total selected numeric schedule fields

tool.name: profile_flex
tool.description: Duplicate family type and instance, set explicit length parameters, verify expected XYZ bounding-box dimensions and original preservation. Does not certify internal geometry.

tool.name: routing_variant
tool.description: Duplicate pipe or duct type and assign explicit fitting rules to empty groups; original unchanged. Requires loaded compatible fittings and actual connectivity checks.

tool.name: native_shapes
tool.description: Create curved wall, flip wall, floor with interior loop or room separation lines

tool.name: native_view_filter
tool.description: Native comment-based parameter filter creation, application, graphic override, visibility and removal

tool.name: quality_checks
tool.description: Category-level mark, direct type usage, room status and host QA; no purge or automatic edits

tool.name: hooked_stirrup
tool.description: Experimental native stirrup with 135 degree hooks and geometry readback; no structural design

tool.name: auto_clearance_repair
tool.description: Diagnose or repair clearance for unhosted furniture against explicit obstacle IDs using conservative bounds and a movement limit; simulation by default. Does not certify clearance against unlisted elements.

tool.name: spatial_repair
tool.description: Discover nearby obstacles in selected local categories and diagnose or repair unhosted furniture clearance within explicit movement limit. Conservative bounds, no linked models or circulation certification.

tool.name: room_repair
tool.description: Discover nearby obstacles and repair unhosted furniture clearance while keeping its bounding box inside an enclosed axis-aligned rectangular room. No circulation or accessibility certification.

tool.name: polygon_repair
tool.description: Repair unhosted furniture clearance within straight-edged polygonal rooms, including concavity and interior boundaries. Selected local obstacle categories; no circulation certification.

tool.name: linked_repair
tool.description: Repair local furniture against explicit linked elements and selected local categories; read-only link, AABB host coordinates, no linked edits.

tool.name: mep_clearance_repair
tool.description: Translate disconnected straight pipes or ducts only; expectedMm is midpoint, preserve endpoints relative to translation, type and disconnection.

tool.name: solid_profile_flex
tool.description: Duplicate and flex family type using physical solid bounds, excludes nonphysical references; reports per-solid boxes. For audit mode supply id and mode=audit; inspect per-solid changes before committing.

tool.name: cylinder_flex
tool.description: Analytic cylinder audit and verified length-parameter flex. Upright full solid cylinder only. Radius changes may be rejected if parameter is not geometrically driving; height tested. Relative volume tolerance 0.01 percent.

tool.name: bitmap_material
tool.description: Duplicate untextured generic material and attach a local TextureFixture PNG in the isolated project directory; verify source and appearance reference. No render quality certification.
